reproduction_manifest.notes: Reproduced ToW=0.9607 on CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 for class 0, alpha=0.6. Within CI bounds [0.956, 0.9868]. Used notebook-inlined engram code with Conv2dHandler (critical for CNNs; installed package only handles nn.Linear). ToW uses approximate retrained-model accuracies (no retrained checkpoints available). DA/NMI not in repo.
reproduction_manifest.eval_output_format: Parse ToW (approximate): <value> from stdout or /repo/repro_output/results.json tow_results.ToW
reproduction_manifest.known_levers: alpha (edit_strength in [0.1, 2.0], best=0.6 per paper grid search): controls forgetting intensity. Higher = more forgetting but more retain degradation.
reproduction_manifest.setup_notes: Base: pytorch/pytorch:2.1.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime. Dependencies: torchvision transformers tqdm pandas seaborn matplotlib. Installed ai-engram from /repo. Key fix: notebook-inlined engram code (notebook_engram.py etc.) for Conv2dHandler — package only handles nn.Linear; ResNet-18 requires Conv2d support. Model: /paper_data/resnet18_cifar10/pytorch_model.bin (edadaltocg/resnet18_cifar10). CIFAR-10 from /datasets/cifar10 (replaced corrupted paper_data archive with valid one from paper 0010).

optimization_objective.summary: Maximize ToW on CIFAR-10 class 0 forgetting with ResNet-18 (alpha=0.6). Guardrail: retain class accuracy must not degrade beyond 3%.

metrics.name: ToW
metrics.rationale: Primary paper metric (Table 2). Measures alignment between unlearned and retrained model.

metrics.name: forget_class_accuracy
metrics.rationale: Accuracy on forgotten class 0. Should approach 0.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Improve ToW over 0.9607 baseline. Retain accuracy must stay above 0.90. Forget accuracy must stay below 0.10. Reject improvements that violate guardrails.
